about: The one source of Harness Manager's web design tokens (decision P4). tools/gen_tokens.py generates the web UI's src/harness_manager/web/static/css/tokens.css from it; `make check` fails when it is stale, or when a stylesheet of the UI (app.css, css/<tab>.css) defines a colour of its own. 'color' and 'effect' are per theme; 'static' is the same in both. 'held' (violet: someone else has it) is decision P6. 'rc-*' are the sidebar's board cards (UI v2 round 3; the dark values are round 3's too). The front panel's palette (P3) is NOT generated from here: see 'panel' (UI v2 risk R2) and docs/design/CLCD_ALIGNMENT.md section 4.

static.font-sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
static.font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

ok.means: working and proven: verified, up, locked, yours and healthy

warn.means: works, but needs attention soon: lease ending, not leased, busy control port

err.means: broken now: link down, program failed, clock dead, wedged

busy.means: an operation is running: programming, rebooting, identify

unk.means: not checked or not known; never drawn like ok

held.means: someone else holds it: the lease, the control port, the panel (DUT)

mine.means: you hold it (the web UI knows who 'you' are; the panel never does)

board.note: N1 display name, lower case with hyphens; the panel shows the same string

shell.note: the static image; never 'SID' or 'static' in UI text

design.note: what the partition holds now (the RM)

overlay.note: the file you program; the card slots hold overlays

program.note: the action; replaces SWAP on the panel

card.note: the user microSD (D13); replaces USD on the panel

lease.note: hub lease; '+N' is the queue length

session.note: a Harness Manager that sent hello within its TTL

harness.note: the board-side engine: bare-metal or linux

panel.about: UI v2 risk R2: the MPS3 front panel's palette (palette.json, clcd_palette.h, which the Linux harness vendors, and panel_codes) is generated from design/panel/tokens.json, a byte-for-byte copy of this file as it was when the web and the panel last shared it (sha256 59011d72..., pinned in tools/gen_tokens.py). The web's theme changes here and never moves the panel; the panel's palette changes there, on purpose (decision P3), and the vendored header changes with it.
